description: H021-A canary follow-up (D162, infrastructure): dividend-feed precision probe for the 9 Select Sector SPDRs + SPY, history 1998-12-01..2017-12-31 only. Compares each distribution amount in QuantConnect's dividend feed with the amount implied by QuantConnect's ADJUSTED series; publishes aggregate statistics of the differences only (no price, amount or return). Re-run of E990-01, whose implied-amount formula had an inverted ratio (D162).
